translations.web: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
translations.bsb: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
translations.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
translations.asv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?
